Bill.BriefDescription: Including members of the Samish Indian Nation for purposes of resident tuition.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to resident tuition rates for American Indianstudents; and amending RCW 28B.15.0131.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28B.15.0131 and 1994 c 188 s 1 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For the purposes of determining resident tuition rates, residentstudents shall include American Indian students who meet twoconditions. First, for a period of one year immediately prior toenrollment at a state institution of higher education as defined in RCW28B.10.016, the student must have been domiciled in one or acombination of the following states: Idaho; Montana; Oregon; orWashington. Second, the students must be members of one of thefollowing American Indian tribes whose traditional and customary tribalboundaries included portions of the state of Washington, or whose tribewas granted reserved lands within the state of Washington: (1) Colville Confederated Tribes; (2) Confederated Tribes of the Chehalis Reservation; (3) Cowlitz Tribe; (4) Hoh Indian Tribe; p. 1 SHB 1607 (((4))) (5) Jamestown S'Klallam Tribe; (((5))) (6) Kalispel Tribe of Indians; (((6))) (7) Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe; (((7))) (8) Lummi Nation; (((8))) (9) Makah Indian Tribe; (((9))) (10) Muckleshoot Indian Tribe; (((10))) (11) Nisqually Indian Tribe; (((11))) (12) Nooksack Indian Tribe; (((12))) (13) Port Gamble S'Klallam Community; (((13))) (14) Puyallup Tribe of Indians; (((14))) (15) Quileute Tribe; (((15))) (16) Quinault Indian Nation; (((16))) (17) Confederated Tribes of Salish Kootenai; (((17))) (18) Samish Indian Nation; (19) Sauk Suiattle Indian Nation; (((18))) (20) Shoalwater Bay Indian Tribe; (((19))) (21) Skokomish Indian Tribe; (((20))) (22) Snoqualmie Tribe; (((21))) (23) Spokane Tribe of Indians; (((22))) (24) Squaxin Island Tribe; (((23))) (25) Stillaguamish Tribe; (((24))) (26) Suquamish Tribe of the Port Madison Reservation; (((25))) (27) Swinomish Indian Community; (((26))) (28) Tulalip Tribes; (((27))) (29) Upper Skagit Indian Tribe; (((28))) (30) Yakama Indian Nation; (((29))) (31) Coeur d'Alene Tribe; (((30))) (32) Confederated Tribes of the Umatilla IndianReservation; (((31))) (33) Confederated Tribes of Warm Springs; (((32))) (34) Kootenai Tribe; and (((33))) (35) Nez Perce Tribe. Any student enrolled at a state institution of higher education asdefined in RCW 28B.10.016 who is paying resident tuition under thissection, and who has not established domicile in the state ofWashington at least one year before enrollment, shall not be includedin any calculation of statefunded enrollment for budgeting purposes, SHB 1607 p. 2 and no state general fund moneys shall be appropriated to a stateinstitution of higher education for the support of such student.
